_purpose: CBS accruals synthesizer factors. Used by utils/accruals_synthesizer.py to populate interest_income_ytd and fee_income_ytd in dev/mock environments where FLEXCUBE isn't connected. Per Rule N1, all factors are configured here, not hardcoded.

_documentation.as_of_date: Date for elapsed-time calculations. Synthesizer accrues from each account's open_date to this date. In production this would be 'today'; in dev it's configurable so scenarios can simulate different YTD points.
_documentation.default_loan_rate_pct: Fallback interest rate when an account's own rate_pct is 0 (the seeded bank may not always populate it). Kenyan retail-loan typical 12-18%.
_documentation.monthly_account_fee_savings: Monthly maintenance fee (KES) for savings accounts. Used as: fee_income_ytd = monthly_fee × months_elapsed.
_documentation.monthly_account_fee_current: Monthly maintenance fee for current accounts. Higher than savings (200 vs 50).
_documentation.monthly_account_fee_term: Monthly fee for fixed/term deposits. Typically 0 — FDs don't carry monthly maintenance fees.
_documentation.monthly_account_fee_loan: Monthly service fee for loan accounts (loan management fee).
_documentation.min_account_age_days: Skip accruals for accounts younger than this. Prevents tiny accruals from very fresh accounts that would round to noise.
